name: translate-toggle
title: Translate toggle
description: Translate a review or comment and back to the original with one quiet control that shows loading, translated-from and failed states.
docs: Nothing is translated unless you pass onTranslate(text), which returns the translated string and runs only when the control is pressed; the result is kept, so going back and forth asks once. Uncontrolled it manages its own state. To control it, pass state with onStateChange, and translation once the state is translated. sourceLocale and locale are the language codes that mark each version with lang, so screen readers switch voice. labels changes the words of the control for a site that is not in English.
